title: Cooling Reliability and Redundancy
summary: Reason about backup cooling, single points of failure, and maintenance impact.
objectives: Explain N+1 and graceful degradation conceptually.

vocab.def: A conceptual design with one additional unit or capability beyond the required amount.
A component or area whose failure can affect a system.
A system continuing at reduced service while managing a failure.

sections.heading: N+1 as a model
sections.body: N+1 means required cooling capability plus one additional modeled unit or capability. It is an introductory reliability concept, not a professional design calculation.

sections.heading: Ask what depends on what
sections.body: Identify single points of failure, alternate capacity, maintenance impact, and monitoring evidence. Facilities use different designs.

practice.prompt: Why can one unavailable cooling unit matter even when temperatures are normal?
practice.answer: It may reduce reserve capacity and increase maintenance or failure risk.

quiz.question: What does N+1 describe here?
options: Required capability plus one modeled backup
quiz.answer: Required capability plus one modeled backup

futureCompetencyCandidates: identify cooling redundancy and failure domains
reflectionPrompt: What evidence would show whether reserve capacity is actually available?
